turns.question: What share of the site sessions that viewed a page on 1 October 2026 added something to the cart?
turns.answer: About 80% (0.8) of the site sessions that viewed a page on 1 October 2026 added something to the cart, counted on that day or the day after. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
